title: Adaptive versus Static Minimax Welfare for Treatment Choice with Rare Conversions
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope; math pass and all four citations verified-attested.
gap_reasons: The delivered contribution is an arbitrary-accuracy characterization and certified positive adaptive gap for one fixed two-arm intensity square, without a structural sampling rule or an evaluated allocation-workflow comparison.
The general accuracy algorithm is exhaustive enumeration without a packaged executable, so the executed certificates establish this numerical benchmark rather than a demonstrated practical solver.
The narrow numerical scope and missing finite-budget workflow evidence keep the package below field and constrain its projected leading-journal score to 5.8.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived and independently math-reviewed the full-square controlled-Poisson minimax benchmark, arbitrary-accuracy certification algorithm, and finite-n minimax separation for n≥731, while repairing theorem references and verifying four primary-source citations. The cold novelty review capped the nominal subfield package at incremental (projected score5.8<7.4), and independent terminal auditing found no bounded field-lifting repair. Exact saddle/switching geometry, a packaged general solver, and evaluated finite-budget workflow comparisons remain open; no Lean formalization was started.
tldr: When conversion probabilities are of order \(1/n\), the full-box controlled-Poisson game is the limiting terminal-welfare minimax benchmark for all original-record adaptive experiments. Executed outward certificates give adaptive value \([0.3336771,0.3343532]\), static value \([0.3631066,0.3631451]\), and \(G\ge0.0287534\). The original values satisfy \(R_n^{\mathrm{stat}}-R_n\ge0.0287534-21/n\), hence strict adaptive minimax advantage for every \(n\ge731\). This finite-sample value comparison uses near-minimizing rules with \(n\) cells; the explicit fixed 512-cell fixture has a separate implementation error and the audited limiting risk guarantee. Generic Poisson approximation, Bayesian control and minimax duality receive full credit. Exact least-favorable support, contacts and continuous switching geometry remain open.
gap: Positive-variance local treatment-choice theory, rare-event fixed-confidence identification, and cumulative-income Poisson control do not evaluate the stated finite-information terminal minimax game.
fill: Uniform original-record comparisons, a quantitative complete-control approximation, outward finite certificates, and the evaluated adaptive/static comparison determine the benchmark without presupposing the shape or attainment of a saddle.
